content.text: Imagine being a digital creator in Nigeria, locked out of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-7|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal, with no way to receive payments for your ebooks, courses, and software. But what if you could break free from this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-what-nobody-4|Solutions When]]-zimbabwean-digital-sellers|infrastructure]] prison and build your own sovereign commerce stack, with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership? With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem isn't with the platforms themselves, but with the infrastructure they're built on. Stripe and PayPal are great for big businesses, but for creators and small teams, they're a bottleneck. They charge exorbitant fees, freeze accounts without warning, and leave you vulnerable to currency fluctuations. But with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can build a payment pipeline that's decentralized, transparent, and under your control. You can choose your own currencies, set your own fees, and keep your customers' data safe from prying eyes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your sovereign commerce stack, you'll need a few things. First, you'll need a website hosted on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. You'll also need a Cloudflare Workers account, where you'll write your custom backend logic using JavaScript. And finally, you'll need a Supabase account, where you'll store your orders and customer data. DON'T WORRY, these tools are free, and you can get started in just a few minutes.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Now it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. With NOWPayments, you can integrate automatic crypto payment verification into your stack. You can choose from over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, with fees that are under $0.10 per transaction. And with Cloudflare Workers, you can write custom logic to handle payment notifications, order updates, and file delivery. You can even use Supabase to store your orders and customer data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your files instantly.
You can choose your own currencies and set your own fees with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. With NOWPayments, you can configure automatic payment verification for your website. And with Cloudflare Workers, you can write custom logic to handle payment notifications and order updates. As soon as a customer makes a payment, your stack will automatically update their order status, and deliver their files instantly. And with NOWPayments, you'll get notified the moment the payment confirms on-chain.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign commerce stack is up and running, you can start scaling. With Cloudflare Workers, you can write custom logic to handle increased traffic, and with Supabase, you can store more orders and customer data. You can even use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver more files instantly. And with NOWPayments, you can process more transactions, and get notified the moment the payment confirms on-chain.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most important question on your mind is probably, 'How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?' The answer is, with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, USDT payments take seconds, not days. You'll get notified the moment the payment confirms on-chain, and your customer will receive their files instantly. With NOWPayments, you can even choose your own currencies, set your own fees, and keep your customers' data safe from prying eyes.

And if you're ready to take the next step, head over to our Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: Set up your website on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Create a Cloudflare Workers account and write your custom backend logic using JavaScript. Set up a Supabase account to store your orders and customer data. Configure automatic crypto payment verification with NOWPayments. Write custom logic to handle payment notifications and order updates with Cloudflare Workers. Store your orders and customer data in Supabase. Deliver your files instantly with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Get notified the moment the payment confirms on-chain with NOWPayments.
